scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @cf-ai-spa/web exec vite" "pnpm exec wrangler dev --enable-containers=false"
scripts.dev:containers: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @cf-ai-spa/web exec vite" "pnpm exec wrangler dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run cf-typegen && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
